story_blocks.title: SkyHarbor Air: Enterprise Context at a Glance
story_blocks.executive_summary: SkyHarbor Air is a complex global passenger airline with cargo, loyalty, maintenance, and digital operations.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: Seven strategic use cases span sourcing, IROPS, crew, contact center, maintenance, and baggage domains.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Operational reliability and managed-services dependency create compounding risk across fragmented evidence layers.
story_blocks.decision_implication: No use case is decision-grade until cross-domain evidence is reconciled and governance owners are confirmed.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: SLA mapping, invoice reconciliation, disruption lineage, transcript governance, and lakehouse certification remain outstanding.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge anchors enterprise context; Source activates only after evidence validation gates are cleared.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Prioritize SLA-to-criticality mapping and IROPS lineage certification as first evidence milestones.

story_blocks.title: Who SkyHarbor Air Is as an Enterprise
story_blocks.executive_summary: SkyHarbor Air operates as a multi-division global airline with significant operational and vendor complexity.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: Passenger, cargo, loyalty, airport, maintenance, and digital divisions create interdependent operational risk exposure.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Multi-division complexity amplifies the cost of irregular operations and managed-services underperformance.
story_blocks.decision_implication: Enterprise profile supports planning-grade framing only; no audited scale or revenue figures are claimed.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: Certified fleet size, route network scope, and division P&L boundaries need evidence before strategic sizing.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge builds enterprise profile narrative to orient all downstream use-case and sourcing analysis.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Request certified organizational scope and division boundary documentation from enterprise architecture team.

story_blocks.title: Core Business Functions Driving AI Priority
story_blocks.executive_summary: Flight operations, crew management, customer experience, maintenance, and sourcing are the primary AI-relevant functions.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: IROPS, crew recovery, contact center, and baggage functions share overlapping data and system dependencies.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Function-level fragmentation means AI use cases cannot be sequenced without cross-function data governance.
story_blocks.decision_implication: Function readiness is hypothesis-grade; no function has certified end-to-end data lineage confirmed.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: Accountable owners per function, data-sharing agreements, and process baseline documentation need validation.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge maps business functions to use cases; Source uses function scope to define sourcing boundaries.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Conduct function-owner interviews to assign accountability and confirm data-sharing readiness per domain.

story_blocks.title: Ownership Gaps Blocking Decision Authority
story_blocks.executive_summary: Policy content ownership and data governance accountability are not yet assigned across critical use cases.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: Contact center policy ownership, crew rule lineage, and maintenance safety controls lack confirmed accountable owners.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Without named owners, AI outputs cannot be approved, audited, or operationally trusted by frontline teams.
story_blocks.decision_implication: Ownership gaps are a governance blocker; no AI use case should advance to production without resolution.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: Named data owners, policy stewards, and AI governance sponsors need formal assignment and documentation.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge surfaces ownership gaps; governance module should track owner assignment as a prerequisite gate.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Map each use case to a named executive sponsor and data steward before next evidence review cycle.

story_blocks.title: Workforce Roles Intersecting AI Transformation
story_blocks.executive_summary: Crew planners, contact center agents, maintenance technicians, and sourcing analysts are primary AI-adjacent roles.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: Agent assist, crew recovery, and maintenance analytics each require role-specific acceptance and QA telemetry.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Without operator acceptance evidence, AI recommendations risk rejection or unsafe override in operational settings.
story_blocks.decision_implication: Role readiness is not yet evidenced; human override capture and QA telemetry are prerequisites for deployment.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: Agent QA telemetry, crew override reason codes, and technician workflow acceptance data need governance approval.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge identifies workforce roles; change management planning should follow role-readiness evidence collection.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Design acceptance telemetry capture for agent assist and crew recovery pilots before any deployment decision.

story_blocks.title: System Landscape: Complex and Partially Integrated
story_blocks.executive_summary: Fourteen systems span reservations, crew, maintenance, baggage, CRM, loyalty, ITSM, and data platforms.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: Legacy reservations and enterprise data warehouse coexist with target-state AWS lakehouse and modern ITSM.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: System fragmentation creates integration risk that blocks real-time AI use cases across IROPS and contact center.
story_blocks.decision_implication: Application dependency mapping is planning-grade; real-time integration evidence is missing for critical use cases.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: PSS-to-CRM real-time integration, lakehouse certification, and CMDB accuracy need validated evidence.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge maps system landscape; architecture review should validate integration readiness before AI sequencing.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Commission CMDB accuracy audit and PSS-CRM integration latency assessment as immediate evidence requests.

story_blocks.title: Data Foundations: Fragmented and Not Yet Certified
story_blocks.executive_summary: Key data domains including disruption lineage, bag scans, maintenance events, and transcripts lack certification.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: Cross-system data lineage is unproven for IROPS, baggage, maintenance, and contact center use cases.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Uncertified data foundations make AI outputs unreliable and expose the enterprise to operational and regulatory risk.
story_blocks.decision_implication: All data-dependent use cases are hypothesis-grade until lineage, completeness, and quality are formally validated.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: Disruption lineage certification, bag scan completeness proof, and maintenance feed reconciliation are outstanding.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge catalogs data gaps; data governance workstream should prioritize lineage certification by use case.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Initiate data quality assessment for IROPS lineage and baggage scan completeness as first certification milestone.

story_blocks.title: Infrastructure Transition: Target State Not Yet Certified
story_blocks.executive_summary: AWS airline data lakehouse is a target-state platform; current-state certification evidence is not yet confirmed.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: Legacy enterprise data warehouse remains the operational anchor while lakehouse migration is in progress.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Uncertified target infrastructure blocks analytics modernization and AI use cases dependent on lakehouse feeds.
story_blocks.decision_implication: Infrastructure readiness is planning-grade; no AI use case should assume lakehouse availability without certification.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: Lakehouse certification status, migration timeline, and data feed reconciliation need formal validation.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge flags infrastructure gaps; architecture team should certify lakehouse readiness before AI sequencing.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Request lakehouse certification report and migration milestone evidence from cloud and data engineering teams.

story_blocks.title: Vendor Ecosystem: High Dependency, Unvalidated Controls
story_blocks.executive_summary: Eight vendors including NorthSky Managed Services and AeroCore anchor critical operational and IT delivery.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: Managed-services dependency is high; SLA commitments, exit rights, and benchmarking terms are not validated.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Unvalidated vendor controls create sourcing leverage risk and limit renegotiation options without legal review.
story_blocks.decision_implication: Vendor dependency is a sourcing risk; no renegotiation or exit strategy should proceed without contract evidence.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: Exit rights, benchmarking clauses, step-in rights, and AI automation commitments need legal and procurement review.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge maps vendor dependencies; Source activates vendor analysis only after contract evidence is validated.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Engage legal and procurement to extract and validate exit, benchmarking, and AI commitment clauses per vendor.

story_blocks.title: IT Spend: Baseline and Value Proof Not Yet Established
story_blocks.executive_summary: IT spend allocation across managed services, platforms, and modernization is not finance-certified at this stage.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: Rate-card variance, change-order leakage, and staffing costs are hypothesized but not reconciled to finance records.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Without a certified spend baseline, sourcing leverage and ROI claims cannot be substantiated for executive decisions.
story_blocks.decision_implication: Spend analysis is planning-grade; savings hypotheses require Tower validation and finance-certified baselines.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: Finance-certified rate cards, invoice-to-SOW reconciliation, and staffing cost mapping need procurement review.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge frames spend context; Source uses validated spend data to build defensible sourcing scope.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Request finance-certified IT spend breakdown and invoice-to-SOW reconciliation from procurement and finance teams.

story_blocks.title: Strategic Programs: Sequencing Risk Is the Primary Concern
story_blocks.executive_summary: Seven active use-case programs span sourcing, operations, customer experience, and analytics modernization.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: Program interdependencies are high; IROPS, crew, and contact center programs share unresolved data dependencies.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Sequencing errors across interdependent programs risk compounding delays and misallocated transformation investment.
story_blocks.decision_implication: Program sequencing is a hypothesis; no program should advance to execution without dependency mapping evidence.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: Cross-program dependency map, milestone owners, and evidence gate criteria need formal program governance.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge maps program landscape; program management office should validate sequencing before resource commitment.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Facilitate cross-program dependency workshop to identify sequencing blockers and assign milestone accountability.

story_blocks.title: AI Use Cases: Promising but Not Production-Ready
story_blocks.executive_summary: Seven AI use cases are identified across sourcing, IROPS, crew, contact center, maintenance, and baggage domains.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: No use case has certified data lineage, operator acceptance telemetry, or governance approval for production deployment.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Premature AI deployment without evidence gates risks operational harm, regulatory exposure, and trust erosion.
story_blocks.decision_implication: All AI use cases are planning-grade; production readiness requires evidence validation across all prerequisite domains.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: Lineage certification, acceptance telemetry, governance approval, and baseline metrics are outstanding for all use cases.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge catalogs AI use cases; each use case requires evidence gate clearance before Source or deployment action.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Define evidence gate criteria for each use case and assign validation owners before next planning cycle.

story_blocks.title: Risk Exposure: Operational, Contractual, and Data Dimensions
story_blocks.executive_summary: Risk spans managed-services contract gaps, uncertified data lineage, and unvalidated AI governance controls.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: SLA misses without business-impact linkage, unreconciled service credits, and missing safety controls are key risks.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Unmitigated risks in vendor contracts and AI data foundations can escalate to operational and regulatory consequences.
story_blocks.decision_implication: Risk posture is not yet evidenced as controlled; each risk domain requires owner assignment and mitigation evidence.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: Safety control review, service-credit reconciliation, legal validation of exit rights, and AI audit trails are needed.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge surfaces risk landscape; risk and controls workstream should prioritize mitigation evidence collection.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Commission risk register review covering vendor, data, AI governance, and safety control domains immediately.

story_blocks.title: Stakeholder Relationships: Alignment Not Yet Confirmed
story_blocks.executive_summary: CIO, CTO, and CDAO teams share overlapping priorities but cross-functional alignment is not yet evidenced.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: Interview signals show consistent pain points across technology, infrastructure, and data leadership teams.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Misaligned stakeholder priorities create sequencing conflicts and slow evidence collection across use cases.
story_blocks.decision_implication: Stakeholder alignment is a hypothesis; formal cross-functional governance is needed before program commitments.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: Cross-functional alignment sessions, shared priority rankings, and governance charter documentation are outstanding.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge maps stakeholder relationships; executive engagement should validate alignment before program launch.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Facilitate CIO-CTO-CDAO alignment session to confirm shared priorities and cross-functional governance structure.

story_blocks.title: Evidence Sources: Synthetic and Needs Validation
story_blocks.executive_summary: Current evidence is planning-grade and synthetic; no production-certified data, contracts, or outcomes are claimed.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: Interview signals, use-case gap lists, and system inventories form the current evidence base for all analysis.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Synthetic evidence supports framing and hypothesis generation but cannot support production or sourcing decisions.
story_blocks.decision_implication: All analysis is advisory until real contracts, invoices, SLA reports, and certified data feeds are validated.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: Real SLA reports, certified invoices, production data feeds, and legal contract extracts are the next evidence tier.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge tracks evidence provenance; each use case should log evidence source type and validation status.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Establish evidence registry mapping each gap to a real document, system, or interview source for validation.

story_blocks.title: Metrics: Baselines Absent, Outcomes Not Yet Measurable
story_blocks.executive_summary: No certified operational, financial, or customer-experience baselines exist to anchor outcome measurement.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: IROPS recovery time, agent handle time, crew recovery cost, and baggage claim rates lack approved baselines.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Without baselines, AI transformation value cannot be measured, reported, or defended to executive stakeholders.
story_blocks.decision_implication: Outcome claims are hypothesis-grade; value measurement requires approved baselines before any AI deployment.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: Operations, finance, and customer-experience baseline datasets need certification from accountable business owners.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge flags metric gaps; analytics team should prioritize baseline certification as a pre-deployment requirement.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Define baseline measurement protocol for each use case and assign metric owners before pilot design begins.

story_blocks.title: Airline Industry Patterns Shaping SkyHarbor's Risk Profile
story_blocks.executive_summary: IROPS sensitivity, crew legality complexity, and managed-services dependency are common airline transformation risks.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: Industry patterns suggest data lineage gaps and vendor lock-in are systemic challenges in airline AI programs.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Industry context validates that SkyHarbor's gaps are not unique but require airline-specific mitigation approaches.
story_blocks.decision_implication: Industry benchmarks are directional only; SkyHarbor-specific evidence must validate any pattern-based hypothesis.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: Airline-specific benchmarking data for SLA performance, AI adoption, and managed-services terms needs sourcing.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge applies industry lens to contextualize gaps; benchmarking evidence should be sourced through procurement.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Source airline industry benchmarking data for managed-services SLA norms and AI adoption maturity comparisons.

story_blocks.title: Expert Perspectives Needed Across Multiple Domains
story_blocks.executive_summary: Legal, procurement, data governance, AI ethics, and operational safety expertise are required across use cases.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: No single expert lens covers the full scope; cross-domain expert engagement is a prerequisite for evidence validation.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Missing expert review in legal, safety, and AI governance domains creates unmitigated risk in transformation planning.
story_blocks.decision_implication: Expert engagement is a planning prerequisite; no use case should advance without domain-specific expert sign-off.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: Legal review of contracts, safety control audit, AI ethics framework, and data governance expert assessments needed.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge identifies expert lens gaps; advisory engagement should be structured before evidence validation begins.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Engage legal, safety, and AI governance experts to review highest-risk use cases in the next planning cycle.

story_blocks.title: Managed Services: High Dependency, Unvalidated Scope
story_blocks.executive_summary: NorthSky Managed Services anchors AMS and IMS delivery; scope, SLAs, and exit terms are not yet validated.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: SLA commitments are not mapped to business criticality; change-order leakage and rate-card variance are hypothesized.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Unvalidated managed-services scope limits sourcing leverage and blocks defensible renegotiation or exit planning.
story_blocks.decision_implication: Managed-services analysis is planning-grade; sourcing action requires validated SLA, invoice, and contract evidence.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: SOW-to-invoice reconciliation, SLA criticality mapping, benchmarking rights, and exit clause validation are needed.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge frames managed-services scope; Source activates AMS/IMS analysis after evidence validation is complete.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Initiate SOW and invoice reconciliation with procurement and request SLA criticality mapping from service management.

story_blocks.title: Operational Processes: Evidence Gaps Block AI Readiness
story_blocks.executive_summary: IROPS, crew recovery, baggage, and maintenance processes lack certified process evidence for AI integration.
story_blocks.what_context_reveals: Cross-system disruption lineage, crew override capture, bag scan completeness, and maintenance feeds are unproven.
story_blocks.why_it_matters: Without certified process evidence, AI models cannot be trained, validated, or trusted in operational environments.
story_blocks.decision_implication: Operational process readiness is not yet evidenced; process certification is a prerequisite for all AI use cases.
story_blocks.evidence_still_needed: Disruption lineage, crew override logs, bag scan completeness, and maintenance work-order feeds need certification.
story_blocks.module_usage: Knowledge maps process evidence gaps; operations team should prioritize process certification before AI design.
story_blocks.next_validation_action: Commission operational process evidence audit covering IROPS, crew, baggage, and maintenance domains immediately.
